geometry_status: assumed solver construction, not OEM tooling; actual G2b TEC retained

feedthroughs.status: assumed Kovar pins/glass proxy; remaining seven seals/holes/pins omitted, no fixed pin temperatures

hot_mount.status: assumed insulating thermal joint; no asserted solder grade

die_attach.status: assumed insulating epoxy-equivalent; no chemistry claim

mct.source: Heckman/Gonzalez/Guha (2008), original Table2, x=.29; k derived from measured density/Cp/diffusivity
mct.policy: piecewise linear in local nodal T; reject outside90..400 K; no x interpolation; no transient calculation

wires.type: hybrid massless 1D Fourier conductance between area-weighted 3D endpoint patches
wires.status: vendor Au bulk proxy, chosen bond length/diameter; no resolved 3D wire arc, no detector electric current/Joule path

electrical_package_policy: S=0 and computational sigma=1e-12 S/m on non-TEC domains, for a connected passive potential extension. This is not physical Au/Kovar conductivity. Fourier thermal model; bound parasitic current/Joule and test100x lower sigma.
boundaries: 300 K on header underside only; all other external faces insulated except equal/opposite hybrid wire endpoint fluxes; no pin-top clamp
heating: uniform actual MCT volume source=(one bias-power representation + absorbed optical thermal power)/volume

sources.geometry: geometry/reference_cad.py and revision6 assumptions, visual dimensions rebuilt independently
sources.TEC: protected G2b constant verification properties; no measured wide-T or OEM-grade accuracy

load_case_definition.representation: external prescribed V*I only; no second V^2/R term and no detector-current PDE

sensitivity_hypothesis_bounds.note: declared engineering assumptions, not measurement uncertainty/confidence; four wires use two parallel bonds per endpoint pair
